Rightsizing rule: for each instance, required_vcpu = current_vcpu * p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7 and required_mem = current_memory_gib * p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8. The recommended type is the cheapest instance_type in the SAME family (from instance_catalog.csv) with vcpu >= required_vcpu and memory_gib >= required_mem. If no type in the family satisfies both, keep the current type. Monthly cost = hourly_usd * 730. What is the recommended instance_type for instance i-a272bb8eabd6?

Data files in your working directory: utilization.csv, instance_catalog.csv.

tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
row = u[u.instance_id=='i-a272bb8eabd6'].iloc[0]
cur = c[c.instance_type==row.instance_type].iloc[0]
req_v = cur.vcpu * row.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
req_m = cur.memory_gib * row.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
print('current', cur.instance_type, req_v, req_m)
fam = c[(c.family==cur.family) & (c.vcpu>=req_v) & (c.memory_gib>=req_m)]
print(fam)
if len(fam):
    print('rec', fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0].instance_type)
else:
    print('rec', cur.instance_type)
